n: FIRST XRP Level 2 Programming with ML and AI
t: A year-long FIRST course outline for programming robots with cameras and AI.
steps: Get the course outline PDF from FIRST.
Choose a platform from the outline, such as an XRP with a Red Vision Kit, a HuskyLens, or an FTC or FRC robot with a camera.
Confirm that students have finished Intro to Robotics Programming.
Ask IT to approve the programming tools and GitHub access that students will need.
Work through the linked FIRST Training content and SparkFun Module 9 yourself.
Plan the year around the outcomes listed in the outline.
Pick a certification path to offer to interested students.
